columns.text: "Creation eagerly awaits the revealing of the sons of God" Rom 8:19-21

The same phrase, the sons of God,  appeared far earlier, they watched God lay the earth’s foundations. Job 38:3-7 Who were these sons of God? So why is creation waiting for you? For what critical role were you created to play?

pages.title: God dwells with His Families
pages.description:
The story of what is happening behind the scenes of Creation - from Genesis to Revelation.

Understand passages there were a little strange instead of passing over them.  You will see and understand the bible like you never did before.

As you read this story, the Word of God will open up next to it with a single click or tap.

columns.text: Before everything existed, Yahweh wanted to dwell with a human family in the garden of Eden.  Love would be basis for every relationship in His presence.1 God, whose name is Yahweh, planned to cover the whole earth with human beings.2 They would be adopted as His children and be sons of God. 3  Eden would end up as the Paradise of God - heaven and earth together, with the tree of Life.4  That was, and still is, God's plan. 2

However, something is not mentioned in that account.  Before Yahweh created the earth, the sons of God were rejoicing; they were not human beings, they were heavenly beings.1 Heavenly beings dwell with God in heaven and minister here on earth. 2   God's plan is to dwell with both His human and heavenly families in Paradise on earth, forever. 3
1 Job 38:4-7 2 Heb 1:14  3 1Co 6:2-3

Yahweh planted the garden of Eden and chose to start with one couple -- Adam and Eve, called Eden, where He walked with them. The tree of life was in the midst of the garden and everything was very good.
1 Gen 1:27 2 Gen 1:28
Their descendants would fill the earth - every one of them created in His image. 1  Yahweh gives them the opportunity to reign as His ambassadors, tending and keeping His creation. 2
1 Gen 1:27 2  Gen 1:28
